title: Gated landings leave a third-party re-runnable receipt in the tree
goal: Every `cargo local-workflow ship` landing writes `.agents/receipts/<verified-commit>.json` (schema susi-gate-receipt-v1: the exact cargo commands the gate ran with their exit codes and durations, the test-binary list with pass/fail/ignored counts, toolchain and host triple, the integration head and the origin/main it merged, sha256 of Cargo.lock and of the rustc version string, and a digest of the body) as a receipt-only commit the same ship publishes on top of the verified head, recorded at refs/susi/receipts/<verified-commit> inside the acceptance ref transaction; publication is refused when the receipt cannot be written. `cargo xtask verify-receipt <commit>` re-runs the recorded commands against that commit in a scratch worktree on a clean clone and reports which results match. Documented in docs/gate-receipts.md.
acceptance: cargo test -p xtask --offline --locked (gate_receipt writer, digest, log parsing, mismatch detection and the ship tests that publish a receipt commit)
